title: Identical Bags
body:
You have n distinct objects and k identical bags. Count the ways to put every object into a bag so that no bag is empty. The bags cannot be told apart, so only which objects end up together matters.

Print the answer modulo 109 + 7.

samples.ex: 4 ways to split 1 + 3 and 3 ways to split 2 + 2.
